# Date picker (`date-picker`)

Calendar popover for one date.

Group: Pickers. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/pickers';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createDatePicker` (types in `dist/web/pickers/datePicker.d.ts`): `.mh-date-picker`: an input-looking button (`.mh-picker-trigger`) that opens a `.mh-picker-popover` with a`.mh-calendar` and optional Today and Clear buttons. Picking a date closes the popover back to the button. Thevalue is an ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), free of time zones.

```ts
export function createDatePicker(options: DatePickerOptions = {}): DatePickerHandle;

export interface DatePickerOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`; the picker then renders the button alone. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: IsoDate | null;
  /** Shown while nothing is picked (default "Choose a date"). */
  placeholder?: string;
  min?: IsoDate | null;
  max?: IsoDate | null;
  isDateDisabled?: (date: IsoDate) => boolean;
  locale?: string;
  weekStartsOn?: Weekday;
  /** How the picked date is written on the button (default the locale's medium date). */
  format?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions;
  /** Adds a Clear button to the popover. */
  clearable?: boolean;
  /** Adds a Today button to the popover (default true). */
  showToday?: boolean;
  /** Submits the ISO date with forms through a hidden input. */
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Portals the popover into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element. */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  onChange?: (value: IsoDate | null) => void;
}

export interface DatePickerHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  trigger: HTMLButtonElement;
  calendar: CalendarHandle;
  popover: PickerPopoverHandle;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): IsoDate | null;
  setValue(value: IsoDate | null): void;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface CalendarHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getValue(): IsoDate | null;
  setValue(value: IsoDate | null): void;
  getRange(): DateRange | null;
  setRange(range: DateRange | null): void;
  /** Shows the month holding `date` (and moves the keyboard focus date there). */
  showMonth(date: IsoDate): void;
  /** Moves keyboard focus to the active day. */
  focus(): void;
}

export interface PickerPopoverHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  open(): void;
  /** Closes; `refocus` returns focus to the anchor (default true). */
  close(refocus?: boolean): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  /** Re-anchors after the content changed size. */
  reposition(): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createDatePicker, pickerDates } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const today = pickerDates.todayIso();
const status = document.createElement('p');

const visit = createDatePicker({
  label: 'Visit date',
  min: today,
  max: pickerDates.addDays(today, 90),
  clearable: true,
  onChange: (date) => {
    status.textContent = date ? `Booked for ${pickerDates.formatDate(date, undefined, { dateStyle: 'full' })}.` : 'No date.';
  },
});

document.body.append(visit.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { DatePicker } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { pickerDates, type IsoDate } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function DatePickerExample() {
  const [today] = useState(() => pickerDates.todayIso());
  const [visit, setVisit] = useState<IsoDate | null>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <DatePicker label="Visit date" min={today} max={pickerDates.addDays(today, 90)} clearable value={visit} onChange={setVisit} />
      <p>{visit ? `Booked for ${pickerDates.formatDate(visit, undefined, { dateStyle: 'full' })}.` : 'No date yet.'}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
